To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a model has been developed for predicting the residual strength of concrete-filled steel columns with rectangular sections exposed to the ISO-34 Standard fire.

the residual strength of concrete-filled steel columns with rectangular sections is significantly affected by the parameters, such steel ratio, steel strength, load eccentricities, slenderness ratios and sectional dimensions.

the model developed in this paper is capable of predicting the residual strength of concrete-filled steel rectangular tubular columns after exposure to the standard fire, which will help the design and analysis of concrete-filled steel columns with rectangular sections in high-rise buildings.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the residual strength of concrete-filled steel rectangular tubular columns after exposure to standard fire.
the residual strength and load-deflection behavior of composite columns with rectangular sections.
the strength of concrete filled steel tubular columns after exposure to the Standard fire, the strength of which has not yet been studied by other researchers.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

, for the composite columns with rectangular sections, the steel ratio, steel strength and load eccentricity have significant influences on the strength loss of composite columns after exposure to the standard fire; the slenderness ratio of the column, length-to-width of the section and concrete strength have little influence; and the sectional dimensions of the composite columns have no influence.
the strength of concrete-filled steel tubes with rectangular sections can be predicted by the model developed in this paper after exposure to the fire.
the strength of concrete-filled steel columns with rectangular sections is significantly reduced after exposure to the standard fire.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the strength loss ratio is sensitive to the steel and concrete strength ratio, and the load eccentricity.
the strength loss of concrete-filled steel columns after exposure to the standard fire is significant.
, the residual strength of concrete-filled steel tube columns with rectangular sections can be calculated with good accuracy by means of the proposed model.
The main takeaway from our work is that
concrete-filled steel tubs are a promising alternative to traditional reinforced concrete columns for use in high-rise buildings.

the concrete filled steel tubular columns are still effective in resisting fire after exposure to the standard fire, and that the simplified model can be used for the preliminary design of such columns.
the strength loss ratio is mainly influenced by steel ratio and steel strength, and the strength loss of columns with a steel ratio of 0.8 and 1.0 is significant.
